title: Average revenue per completed order, by category, H1 2025
prompt: Merchandising wants to compare product categories: for completed orders in the first half of 2025 (Jan–Jun), what's the average revenue per order that included each category?
population: Completed orders placed between 2025-01-01 and 2025-07-01, and their order_items joined to product category.
metricDefinition: sum(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) across matching order_items, divided by count of distinct orders, grouped by category.
referenceSql: SELECT p.category, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.category

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT p.category, avg(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.category
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Averages per line item, not per order — an order with 3 items of the same category gets counted 3 times, understating the true per-order average.
